name: Empty: An eye experience
source:
'Empty' is a psychological horror visual novel with the dreamcore/weirdcore style based on different dreams the developer have had. 
This novel is a critique of Christianity.

[Edited from [url=https://anjin16.itch.io/empty-an-eye-experience]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Empty》是一部心理恐怖视觉小说，具有基于开发者所做的不同梦境的梦核/怪异核风格。
这部小说是对基督教的批判。

[编辑自[url=https://anjin16.itch.io/empty-an-eye-experience]Itch.io[/url]]
